text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The members of Team Zenith have begun secretly holding extra training sessions without Ms. Kashimoto's consent.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I can't put my finger on why, but Team Zenith seems different than usual!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I saw them having a really serious conversation over dinner in the dorm's cafeteria yesterday!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: They all usually eat on their own, so I was really surprised!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, as Taiki Shuttle and I return from a training session…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We see Team Zenith getting harshly scolded by Ms. Kashimoto.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Did you really think I wouldn't notice?! Do you take me for a fool?

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Not at all! We just…

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: We felt like we hadn't improved anywhere near as much as the other team when we ran against them in the practice match, so—

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: That's not for you to concern yourselves with!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: It is! You've worked hard to tailor individual training regimens for us!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: And yet we still failed you. It's our fault we're not good enough, and if it means putting in extra hours in to rise to your standards, then—

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: I never asked any of you to do something so unnecessary!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: All you need to do is run as I say! That's it! I'm telling you this for your own sakes!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: …It seems I've gotten a little worked up. Practice is over for today.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Sorry… This is all my fault.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: None of her teammates say anything in response. I find myself holding my breath due to the thick tension in the air, but then…

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: What in tarnation was all that about? None of that made any dang sense!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: None of y'all are in the wrong! It's only natural to want to improve.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: If you ask me, Ms. Kashimoto's not valuing y'all enough!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: You're wrong.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: She cares for us, and everything she does is in our best interest.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: Our diets, our training regimens—they all come from her concern for our well-being.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The other members nod their heads in assent.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even if she cares for them, her methods are too uncompromising. She won't humor any other way of doing things but her own.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And why is Director Akikawa still standing by and letting Ms. Kashimoto continue like this? There are too many things that don't add up here.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Suddenly, I remember something Tazuna told me before.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Director Akikawa knows the academy better than anyone, so she can probably see things others can't.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Perhaps the director knows something the rest of us don't. I decide to take my team and Team Zenith to see her so we can have a proper talk.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thankfully, she understands our concerns quickly.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Ah, understood! Yes, you have every right to know.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Allow me to enlighten you on why Ms. Kashimoto is so excessively strict on her athletes! Perk up those ears!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Director Akikawa explains that Ms. Kashimoto was once a trainer who respected the freedom of the Umamusume she oversaw.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She developed a close relationship with her trainee, and they achieved amazing results in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But then the Unity Cup began, pitting teams of racers against one another.

text_block_list.name: Trainee
text_block_list.text: I wonder what it's like to race in a team? I'll get to train together with other Umamusume too, right?!

text_block_list.name: Trainee
text_block_list.text: I… I've never had many friends before, so I'm excited!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: I am too. I look forward to seeing how you improve in the days to come.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, the other team members' abilities were below average, and the gap between them and Ms. Kashimoto's trainee was stark.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: You want to do extra training in your own time with the rest of the team? But—

text_block_list.name: Trainee
text_block_list.text: I know the Twinkle Series should be my priority!

text_block_list.name: Trainee
text_block_list.text: But I feel like I could teach them a lot.

text_block_list.name: Trainee
text_block_list.text: I want to help them to the best of my ability! Please, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her trainee worked hard to bridge the gap between herself and her teammates.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: You seem exhausted.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Your graded race in the Classics is coming up, so maybe you should refrain from running in the next Unity Cup match.

text_block_list.name: Trainee
text_block_list.text: But if I don't run with them, our team's ranking is bound to drop.

text_block_list.name: Trainee
text_block_list.text: It's been so hard to get this far, and I don't want to forfeit all our hard work. I want to do this!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: …Very well. I shall respect your wishes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ms. Kashimoto was afraid that putting the brakes on their training would ruin the team's camaraderie.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: So she decided to trust in her trainee and her team.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, one day…

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: A runner has just taken a fall just before the third corner! Is she okay?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The sound of sirens echoed across the racecourse…

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: Her poor form and resulting fall was due to a stress fracture. She must have been overworking herself quite significantly.

text_block_list.name: Doctor
text_block_list.text: There will be no lasting problems in regard to her everyday life, but in terms of her career as a racer…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Following that accident, Ms. Kashimoto's trainee could run no longer professionally and ended up dropping out of Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: This wouldn't have happened if I had paid closer attention to her!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: A tragic conclusion! Ms. Kashimoto blamed herself for letting her trainee follow her emotions to the point of ruin.

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: As a result, she developed an uncompromising belief that total control over her racers is the only way to keep them safe!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: B-but…

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Trainer Kashimoto's Operation Oversight is so well organized, and we improved so much because of her!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: No doubt! Ms. Kashimoto's skills are unparalleled, and they provide essential benefits for the Umamusume under her watch!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: That is why I'm trying to find a solution to all this myself! I want to bring her to her senses as much as any of you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Finally it all makes sense. Ms. Kashimoto's attitude, Director Akikawa's behavior…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, everyone is stunned speechless at Ms. Kashimoto's tragic history.
